name: Formesign
author: manidoraisamy

sections.description:
Collect signature in Google Forms™.

Try it out

Step 1: Login to your WordPress site as an admin
Step 2: Install and Activate the Formesign WordPress plugin for Google Forms™
Step 3: Follow the prompts to add signature & embed the Google Forms™

Features

Legally binding signatures

Formesign ensures that signatures collected through Google Forms™ are legally enforceable, meeting electronic signature regulations

Collect multiple signatures

Incorporate additional signatures for witness, guardian etc, ensuring all necessary parities sign the document before form submission.

Google drive integration

Automatically convert the form responses into signed pdf files and sync them to your Google Drive folder when the user submits the for

Email signed forms

Send customized emails with signed pdf files to respondents & collaborators for seamless communication and record-keeping

Seamless signing experience

Easily sign forms on any device, including mobiles and tablets, for convenient, secure and accessible signing experience

Design professional forms

Craft visually appealing & professional-looking forms by selecting your preferred layout brand colors, fonts and language

Google sheets integration

Automatically sync responses to Google Sheets, providing a familiar interface for organising and analysing the data

Pricing

  • Free 7-day trial.
  • Paid plan starts at $18 for 100 responses per month.

Ask support@formesign.com for questions.

External service used in this plugin

This plugin uses our external web service (Formesign). This external service provides two functionality:

  • Connect Google Account to create Google Forms™.
  • Covert the Google Form into a WordPress specific form that renders natively.
  • Submit the form details using AJAX without redirecting the user to a Google Form page.

Formesign collects personal and non-personally identifiable information solely for the purpose of providing our services to you (i.e. to submit the form). You can read our privacy policy here: https://formesign.com/privacy.html
